visualCharacteristics: A 4-up grid of article cards, each with an image, a small uppercase tag label (e.g. ARTICLE), and a linked title. 2-up on mobile, 4-up on desktop. Card-feed styling distinct from promo/nav cards.
contentPattern: One row per article. Image cell (picture only) + body cell (tag label paragraph + linked title).
usage: Latest-articles / editorial feed linking to content pages.
